description: Fee records with a fee rate of exactly 0.0009 are included along with those above it.

c.request: Using only high-rate fee records, with 0.0009 on the fee rate (`feerate`) as the cutoff, match each fee to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and trading pair (`mktnote`), show `orderslink`, the trading pair, the average maker rebate rate (`rebrate`), and the total rebate (the sum of `rebtotal`), ignoring missing values. Sort by total rebate from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round. Fee records with a fee rate of exactly 0.0009 are included along with those above it.
c.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote AS trading_pair, AVG(f.rebrate) AS average_maker_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

d.request: Select fee records with `feerate >= 0.0009`, inner join them to orders on exact text equality `fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault`, and group by `fees.orderslink` and `orders.mktnote`. For each group, return the order link, trading pair, average nonmissing `rebrate`, and sum of nonmissing `rebtotal`; sort by total rebate descending with missing totals last, return the top 10, and do not round.
d.sql:
SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS average_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate
FROM fees AS f
INNER JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote
ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

a.request: Take fee records with a fee rate (`feerate`) of at least 0.0009 and match each to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and trading pair (`mktnote`), show `orderslink`, the trading pair, the average maker rebate rate (`rebrate`), and the total rebate (the sum of `rebtotal`), ignoring missing values. Sort by total rebate from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round.
a.sql:
SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate
FROM fees AS f
JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote
ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

b.request: Include fee records where `feerate` is at least 0.0009, match them to orders by exact text equality between `fees.orderslink` and `orders.recordvault`, and exclude fees without a matching order. Group by `orderslink` and `mktnote`; return each `orderslink`, trading pair, average nonmissing `rebrate`, and sum of nonmissing `rebtotal`. Sort by total rebate descending with missing totals last, return the top 10, and do not round.
b.sql:
SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS average_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate
FROM fees AS f
INNER JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote
ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
